notes: VibeCoin (src/VibeCoin.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 built on OpenZeppelin v5.4.0 ERC20. name() returns "Vibe Coin", symbol() returns "VIBE", decimals() returns 18. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 VIBE (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which at launch is the ProjectFactory; it also emits a one-off SupplyMinted event. There is no owner, no mint function, no pause, blacklist, freeze or burnFrom, no fee or burn on transfer, no receive or fallback, no proxy, and no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT, so the supply can never change after construction and every launch flow (factory to MerkleDistributor, pool seed through the PoolManager, remainder to economics.remainderTo, distributor claims and swaps) moves exactly the amount requested without any exemption list. The token needs no $factory, $poolManager or $launchNumber argument because it has no transfer rules. No application contracts are part of this launch (contracts is empty). pool.initialPrice is provenance only: the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (3,000 IMD for the whole supply) and totalSupply.
